# Contributing to CUTROOM

CUTROOM is a beta video editor. Helpful contributions include reproducible bug reports, clearer documentation, accessibility improvements, translations, and focused code changes.

- Read the [contributor guide](../docs/CONTRIBUTING.md) for setup, project structure, checks, and the pull request workflow.
- Use the repository's [issue forms](https://github.com/VanoPeradze/cutroom/issues/new/choose) for bugs and feature ideas. Search existing issues first.
- Follow the [security policy](SECURITY.md) to report a suspected vulnerability privately.

Use synthetic or non-sensitive examples. Do not submit private footage, transcripts, client information, API keys, local configuration, or generated project data in issues, pull requests, or attachments.

Contributions are made under the project's [MIT License](../LICENSE). Include only material you have permission to share and preserve applicable [third-party notices](../docs/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md).
